method: Feature count and scoped ID/name equality against pinned release collections. These are source accounting checks, not geographic validation.

scoped_geometry_screen.purpose: Flag geometries for manual reference comparison only. No topology, area, city fragmentation, coast/island or omission conclusions are made from source format.

explicit_limits: Count agreement does not prove completeness.
Scoped shapeID/name identity does not prove current legal identity, parent or geographic truth.
The source geometry screen reports representation types and bbox only; it is not an authoritative boundary comparison.
